meta.name: writing-great-skills
meta.description: Reference for writing and editing skills well — the vocabulary and principles that make a skill predictable.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 编写和编辑高质量 skill 的参考指南
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你正在创建或改进一个 agent skill。
copy.tagline_en: Write and edit high-quality skills with this reference guide
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are creating or improving an agent skill.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会按照技能编写规范来创建或编辑技能，确保技能行为可预测。它会使用特定术语和原则，如“领先词”、“信息层级”等，来组织内容。
howto.when: 当用户要求编写或编辑一个技能，或者提到“技能编写”、“SKILL.md”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 帮我写一个技能，用于代码审查。
say.note: Claude 会按照规范生成技能文件。

say.text: 编辑我的技能，使其更可预测。
say.note: Claude 会应用修剪和去重原则。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will follow skill-writing conventions to create or edit skills, ensuring predictable behavior. It uses specific vocabulary and principles like 'leading words' and 'information hierarchy' to organize content.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to write or edit a skill, or mentions keywords like 'skill writing' or 'SKILL.md'.

say_en.text: Write a skill for code review.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a skill file following the conventions.

say_en.text: Edit my skill to make it more predictable.
say_en.note: Claude will apply pruning and deduplication principles.
